name: Infinite Column Gallery
description: Full-viewport gallery of vertical image columns that loop endlessly in alternating directions, speeding up with page scroll velocity, with a blended headline over the top.
contents: Columns of images, each looping vertically
Centered overlay headline with difference blend
behavior: Even columns drift up, odd columns drift down, in seamless loops
Page scroll speed boosts the drift, then eases back to normal
Images are grayscale at rest and turn to color on hover
editableByProps: Number of columns, images per column, and image sources
Loop speeds, scroll boost strength and decay
Gaps, corner radius, grayscale, background and headline text, color, size and font

needsCodeEdit.change: Make odd columns drift the same direction as even columns
needsCodeEdit.where: isOdd handling inside the fromTo call

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a different hover effect on images

fixed: Includes a 500vh scroll surface so the page has room to scroll and drive the speed boost
Gallery and headline are position fixed over the whole viewport while mounted
Loads the headline Google Font by adding a link tag to the document head and removes it on unmount
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
